description: Namur - thermographie moyenne par bâtiment et par quartier is a group of related datasets listed in Open Data Wallonie Bruxelles, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Ville de Namur. Cartographie des bâtiments réalisée à partir de la modélisation 3D de Namur. En attributs, les valeurs moyennes sur les différents pans de toit du résultat de la thermographie aérienne effectuée les nuits du 16 au 17 et du 23 au 24 février 2018. Attention, pour permettre la compraison sur. Coverage: Namur. The portal lists 2 related datasets of one publisher (copies, years or sister lists), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under Energie. Its keywords are Thermographie, Bâtiment, Toiture, Energie, Pavillon, Namur3D. The portal shows 62,540 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The most recent modification among them is 2018-06-04 on the portal. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support building stock, energy use and retrofit studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-odwb-be-portal.
